components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Primary conversion action across landing and webinar pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #5f3add; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7857f8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5f3add; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AYO LLC's visual system balances refined editorial warmth with modern digital agency craft. Crisp alabaster and pure-white reading surfaces give published book covers, partner marks, and client stories room to breathe, while deep indigo and royal violet establish clear authority and interactive focus.

Surfaces stay calm and structured rather than ornamental. Generous section rhythm, balanced headings, and restrained borders keep visitors oriented whether they are browsing agency capabilities, exploring published works, or completing a registration flow.
keyCharacteristics: Alabaster and pure-white alternating section bands paired with deep indigo headers
Royal violet reserved strictly for primary actions, active states, and focus rings
Plus Jakarta Sans geometric headings paired with Geist body copy for crisp legibility
Flat-by-default cards framed by 1px hairline borders and soft ambient shadows on elevated containers

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Royal violet is reserved for primary actions, active navigation, and focus indicators; never flood entire content sections with saturated violet.

rules.name: The Slate Ink Contrast Rule
rules.body: Supporting copy on light surfaces uses slate ink or darker neutrals so body text maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Display and section headings use balanced line wrapping (text-balance) to prevent single-word orphans across mobile and desktop breakpoints.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content cards stay flat with 1px hairline borders; reserve larger ambient shadows for primary conversion containers and floating overlays.

dos: Do alternate full-bleed section backgrounds (alabaster, soft stone, pure white) so sections read as distinct chapters without heavy dividers.
Do pair every form input with an explicit <label htmlFor> and clear focus-visible ring.
Do use real published book covers, partner marks, and confirmed testimonials from data.ts and config/webinar.ts.
donts: Don't constrain full-bleed background sections with max-w-* without centering, which leaves uneven background strips on wide viewports.
